items.title: Transcription ke marhale aur mRNA ki tayyari (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the phases of transcription and mRNA processing (PDF 133-136).

blocks.text: Primer ki zaroorat nahi. RNA polymerase template DNA par aik khaas silsile, promoter, se jurta hai jo khud transcribe nahi hota.

blocks.caption: Promoter silsile
rows: -35 sequence, start point se taqreeban 35 nucleotides pehle

blocks.alt: Do DNA lakeerein, +1 start teer se pehle promoter dabbe. Prokaryote: TTGACA par -35 sequence aur TATAAT par -10 sequence. Eukaryote: GGCCAATCT par CAAT box (-70) aur TATAAA par TATA box (-25). Neeche: prokaryotic RNA polymerase ke paanch subunits, do alpha, beta prime, beta aur sigma, un ke kaam ke saath.
blocks.caption: Promoters aur RNA polymerase ke subunits (Figure 19.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Transcription ko primer nahi chahiye. RNA polymerase aik khaas silsile, promoter, se jurta hai jo khud transcribe nahi hota. Prokaryotes mein promoter mein start point se taqreeban 35 nucleotides pehle TTGACA (-35 sequence) aur 10 pehle TATAAT (-10 sequence) hota hai; eukaryotes mein TATA box TATAAA taqreeban 25 pehle (-25) aur CAAT box GGCCAATCT taqreeban 70 pehle (-70) hai. Prokaryotic RNA polymerase ke paanch subunits hain: do alpha regulatory proteins se jurte, beta prime template DNA se, beta RNA nucleotides se aur sigma promoter pehchaan kar banana shuru karta hai.

blocks.text: RNA polymerase ke paanch subunits hain: do alpha regulatory proteins se jurte, beta prime template DNA se, beta RNA nucleotides se, aur sigma promoter pehchaan kar banana shuru karta hai. Enzyme ke promoter se jurne ke baad sigma subunit hat jata hai, aur baqi chaar, yaani core enzyme, helix khol kar base pairs torte aur transcription bubble banate hain jis mein RNA zanjeer jurti hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat: RNA polymerases
blocks.text: Prokaryotes mein aik RNA polymerase teeno qisam ke RNA banata hai. Eukaryotes mein teen hain: RNA polymerase I nucleolus mein rRNA, RNA polymerase II mRNA aur RNA polymerase III tRNA banata hai.

Bubble ke andar RNA polymerase template ke saath 5' se 3' ki simt mein complementary ribonucleotides ki zanjeer banata hai, aam taur par A ya G se shuru. Nucleotides ribonucleoside triphosphates (rNTPs) ki shakal mein aate; har aik ke jurne par do phosphate tawanai ke saath alag hote hain. Kitab ke mutabiq naye mRNA ke pehle 12 bases template ke saath aarzi helix banate jo 3' sire ko agla nucleotide lene ke liye jagah par rakhta hai; har nucleotide ke saath RNA-DNA helix ghoomta aur 3' sira catalytic site par rehta hai. Bubble DNA par aage barhta, barhta mRNA bahar nikalta aur DNA peeche dobara lipat jata hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: transcription bubble jahan DNA strands RNA polymerase ke dashed khaake ke andar alag hain; surkh RNA thore se hisse mein template strand se jura, RNA-DNA helix, aur us ka 5' sira bubble se bahar latakta. Neeche: termination, RNA G-C joron se bani hairpin mein mura, phir UUUU jo template ke AAAA se kamzor jura hai, polymerase rukta aur RNA chhoot jata hai.
blocks.caption: Transcription bubble mein elongation aur GC hairpin par termination (Figures 19.14 aur 19.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Promoter se jurne ke baad RNA polymerase apna sigma subunit chhor deta hai; core enzyme DNA khol kar transcription bubble banata hai. Is ke andar enzyme template strand ka complementary RNA 5' se 3' ki simt mein, aam taur par A ya G se shuru kar ke, ribonucleoside triphosphates se banata hai, har aik se do phosphate tawanai ke saath alag hote hain. Naye RNA ke pehle bases template ke saath aarzi helix banate hain jo 3' sire ko active site par rakhta hai; bubble aage barhta aur DNA peeche dobara lipat jata hai. Gene ke aakhir mein GC se bhara hissa aur phir AT jore transcribe hote hain; RNA GC hairpin banata hai jo polymerase ko rok deta hai, aur kamzor U-A jore RNA ko alag hone dete hain, transcription khatam.

blocks.text: Gene ke aakhir mein stop region hota hai: G-C base pairs ka silsila aur phir A-T pairs ka silsila. Jab yeh transcribe hota hai to mRNA strand ke andar hydrogen bonds bante aur aik chhalla, GC hairpin, banta hai jis ke baad chaar ya zyada U nucleotides ki dum hoti hai. Hairpin RNA polymerase ko rok deta hai, aur RNA aur DNA ke darmiyan U-A jore, jo sab se kamzor hain, lambe waqfe mein RNA-DNA hybrid ko thaam nahi sakte, is liye RNA alag ho jata aur transcription ruk jati hai.
Prokaryotes mein nucleus nahi, is liye cytoplasm mein bana un ka mRNA foran translation shuru karta hai. Eukaryotes mein naya mRNA nucleus se cytoplasm jata hai aur raaste ke liye badla jata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qataarein. Naya mRNA: exon 1, intron, exon 2, intron, exon 3. Wahi 5' sire par narangi cap aur 3' sire par hari AAAA...A dum ke saath. Pukhta mRNA jis mein introns nikal kar exons 1, 2 aur 3 cap aur dum ke darmiyan jure hain. Note cap, dum aur splicing samjhata hai.
blocks.caption: Eukaryotic mRNA ka cap, dum aur splicing (Figure 19.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Prokaryotic mRNA foran use hota hai, lekin eukaryotic mRNA ko nucleus se cytoplasm jana hota hai aur pehle badla jata hai. Pehle nucleotide se aik methylated G nucleotide 5' se 5' jor kar 5' cap banta hai jo mRNA ko nucleases aur phosphatases se bachata hai. 3' sire par taqreeban 250 A nucleotides poly-A dum ki shakal mein lagaye jate hain jo ise tootne se bachate hain. Naye mRNA mein exons hote hain jo translate hote, aur introns jo nahi hote; splicing introns nikal kar exons jorti aur pukhta mRNA banti hai.

items: 5' cap: mRNA ka pehla nucleotide A ya G hota hai; is se methylated G nucleotide 5' se 5' bond se jorra jata hai. Cap raaste mein mRNA ko nucleases aur phosphatases se bachata hai.
3' poly-A dum: 3' sire par taqreeban 250 A nucleotides ki zanjeer jo mRNA ko nucleases se tootne se bachati hai.
Splicing: naye mRNA mein introns hote hain jo protein ka code nahi dete, aur exons jo translate hote hain. Splicing introns nikal kar exons jorti aur pukhta mRNA banati hai.

blocks.prompt: Eukaryotic mRNA ko cap aur dum ki zaroorat kyun hai, prokaryotic ko kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotic mRNA ko nucleus se cytoplasm jana hota hai aur cap aur dum raaste mein enzymes se bachate hain. Prokaryotic mRNA cytoplasm mein banta aur foran translate hota hai.

items: Initiation: RNA polymerase (sigma) promoter se jurta; primer nahi.
Elongation: chalte bubble mein rNTPs se RNA 5' se 3'.
Termination: GC hairpin + U dum RNA chhorti.
Eukaryotes: 5' cap, poly-A dum, introns ki splicing.
